name: TextBox 2
text:
Data: 3,000,000 flight-level records with FL_DATE and DEP_DELAY. Cleaning retained 2,922,356 flights with nonmissing date and departure delay.
Observed calendar: 1,704 daily intervals from 2019-01-01 to 2023-08-31.
Delayed flight: DEP_DELAY > 0 minutes.
Mean departure delay: 10.123 minutes. Empirical SD: 49.252 minutes.
Delayed flights: 992,843, or 33.974%.

MGF: M_X(t) = (1-p+p e^t)^n, t in R.
Theory: Blitzstein and Hwang (2019).

name: TextBox 2
text:
Peer-reviewed journal article: Mitsokapas, Schäfer, Harris, and Beck (2021), Scientific Reports.
The study statistically characterized arrival delays at UK airports during 2018–2020 and reported broad delay behavior.
Connection: the project’s daily count variance greatly exceeds its Poisson mean, so a simple Poisson model is a benchmark rather than a fitted conclusion.
Mueller and Chatterji (2002) remains background: it is an AIAA technical-forum paper, not the journal article used here.

name: TextBox 2
text:
The flight-level results support five distinct probability experiments.
Poisson provides a count benchmark but overdispersion is substantial.
Revised daily-rate thresholds avoid the earlier degenerate Binomial and Geometric results.
All five 10,000-draw simulations closely match their theoretical moments.
Interpret results as describing this sample, not every scheduled U.S. flight.
